name: Viv'Nia's training lightsaber
description: Viv'Nia's training lightsaber was a training lightsaber used by Jedi Initiate Viv'Nia Nia'Viv during the High Republic Era. The lightsaber was supplied by an armory pool and was incapable of inflicting lethal damage. It had a standard basic appearance with a metallic silver hilt and shiny black segments around its midsection. It was optimally balanced for the repeated execution of basic defensive forms.
